input.quote: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party. Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement,
input.rationale: Paragraph 4(a) is the only convenience-termination mechanic in the Agreement (4(b) covers breach and insolvency; no Exhibit adds termination terms). It fails the fallback on a material term because the mutual for-any-reason right lets Kubient exit at any point during a renewal period with no effective date tied to a term boundary, which is a Vendor mid-term convenience exit rather than natural-term non-renewal. We therefore target the fallback and split the sentence: our 90 days' notice for-any-reason right is stated expressly, and Kubient's termination on the same 90 days' notice is effective only at the end of the then-current Term. The early-termination-fee element is already met, since the only termination payment is Kubient's entitlement to fees generated during the 90-day termination period (i.e. no more than three months of fees). Preferred wording (30 days plus a pro-rata prepaid-fee refund) is not pursued because the fallback is reached; the exactly 12-month Initial Term lock-out is noted rather than flagged.

ops.oldText: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Customer may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to Kubient. Kubient may terminate this Agreement upon ninety (90) days written notice to Customer, effective only at the end of the then-current Term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have split the mutual for-any-reason exit so that our 90 days' notice right stands on its own and Kubient's termination is effective only at the end of the then-current Term; the Initial Term lock-out and the fee mechanic are unchanged.
proposal.summary: Split 4(a) exit: Customer 90-day convenience right; Kubient only at end of the then-current Term
